name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
detailed_description:
Set out on an epic journey to the heart of an uncharted island in the Lost Ruins of Arnak. As an enthusiastic archaeologist, you'll lead your expedition into a realm of ancient secrets, mighty guardians, and powerful artifacts. Can you overcome all the dangers and uncover the mysteries before your rivals?

Deploy your archaeologists to explore the island's jungle and temples thoroughly. Discover new, challenging locations that promise valuable resources but may awaken fearsome Guardians. 

Pick the character that best represents your strategy and personality—each one comes with a unique ability and distinct playstyle. With four asymmetrical leaders to choose from, every expedition offers a new path to victory.

Arnak blends the tactical depth of worker placement with the evolving strategy of deck-building. Optimize your turns, plan ahead, and adapt to the ever-changing landscape of the island and your opponents' moves.

Start with a small deck of cards, then build up its strength. As you delve deeper into the jungle, new Item cards become scarcer, giving way to mysterious and powerful Artifacts. Choose wisely when to shift your focus from the Items to the Artifacts to build the strongest deck and overcome any obstacle the island throws your way.

Chain actions together for powerful turns! Find that missing resource to push your research, recruit a helpful ally, or overcome a fearsome guardian—all in a cascade of satisfying tactical combos.

Advance on the Research Track to reach the island’s hidden temple. Studying ancient texts guides you toward the long-lost ruins, with each step granting an immediate bonus and significant end-game points. With careful resource management, this offers some great combos.

The island and its most valuable secrets are protected by mysterious Guardians. Appeasing those mighty creatures of Arnak is a perilous challenge, but once you earn their trust, they will help you on your journey. Fail, and you’ll accumulate “fear” cards, cluttering your deck. 

  • Engaging Campaigns: Play through a series of challenging scenarios with unique objectives.

  • Various AI Opponents: Challenge AI opponents, ranging from novice explorers to master archaeologists, with adjustable difficulty levels.

  • Online Multiplayer (1-4 Players): Test your strategies against friends or players worldwide in ranked online games.

  • Unconventional deck-building: Discover dozens of unique Item and Artifact cards, ensuring every game feels different.

  • Comprehensive Tutorial: Learn the basics effortlessly with an intuitive and interactive tutorial.

  • Leaderboard Integration: Compete for top scores on global leaderboards.

Lost Ruins of Arnak await your arrival! Gather your expedition and prepare to uncover the secrets of Arnak!

short_description: Uncover mysteries on an epic journey to the heart of the uncharted island of Arnak in this captivating blend of deck-building and worker placement. Become the leader of an expedition and dive deep into uncharted territory. But you’re not alone—and fame and glory await only the most successful team.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2GHz processor from the last 10-15 years
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: CPU: 3GHz processor from the last 10 years
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics from the last 5 years with full Vulkan 1.4 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8600M GT (256 MB) or ATI Radeon HD 2600 Pro (256 MB)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 15
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 650M (1 GB) or ATI Radeon HD 5670 (512 MB) or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
